name: util_rewriteZeroCashRunPaymentsAsFree
description: One-time data correction, run BY HAND by the developer — never called by the API or any client. Historic run payments recorded as cash / bank transfer / hash credit (PaymentType 3, 4, 6) with ZERO money moved (CreditAmount = 0 AND DebitAmount = 0: price was zero and no extras) are fictions created by the treasurer's tap on a free-for-members run. Rewrites them to PaymentType 2 (Free) with the 'member' provenance tag in Notes (only when Notes is NULL), matching what hcapp_processPayment 1.4.0 records going forward, so payment reports read consistently across old and new runs. Scope: ProductType 1 only; PaymentType 3/4/6 only (5/7/8 carry deliberate amounts); live rows only (CancelledDate IS NULL). updatedAt is stamped so the rewritten rows flow to clients through the normal payment delta sync. @dryRun = 1 (default) reports what WOULD change and writes nothing. Returns a per-kennel preview, a totals row and the success envelope; on error, only the envelope. Still deployed with every release because it is a CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE; it is idempotent (a second real run finds nothing).

rowsets.name: PerKennelPreview
rowsets.description: One row per kennel with at least one matching payment, most affected first. Returned on both dry and real runs, BEFORE the rewrite (so on a real run it shows what was about to change). Empty when nothing matches. Not returned when the CATCH runs.

columns.name: rowsAffected
columns.description: Matching HC.Payment rows in that kennel.

rowsets.name: RewriteTotals
rowsets.description: Always exactly one row on success.

columns.name: totalRewritten
columns.description: Rows updated (0 on a dry run).

columns.name: wasDryRun
columns.description: 1 when nothing was written, 0 when the rewrite ran.

rowsets.name: SuccessEnvelope
rowsets.description: One row { Success 1, NULL } after the COMMIT. When the CATCH runs it is the ONLY rowset, at index 0: { Success 0, ErrorMessage }.

columns.name: Success
columns.description: 1 on success, 0 when the CATCH block ran.

columns.name: ErrorMessage
columns.description: NULL on success; ERROR_MESSAGE() from the CATCH block on failure.

sideEffects: @dryRun = 0: UPDATE HC.Payment SET PaymentType = 2, Notes = COALESCE(Notes, 'member'), updatedAt = GETDATE() for every matching row, inside a transaction.
On any runtime error: rolls back, inserts one HC.ErrorLog row (HcVersion '<unknown>'), returns { Success 0, ErrorMessage } as the only rowset.

codeSmells.issue: updatedAt set with GETDATE() into a DATETIMEOFFSET(7) column
codeSmells.detail: Line 58: updatedAt = GETDATE() (server-local DATETIME, implicitly converted). HC.Payment.updatedAt is DATETIMEOFFSET(7) and the sync watermarks compare instants; SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() is what the rest of HC6 writes. Right on Azure SQL (UTC) but worth fixing if the proc is ever re-run.

codeSmells.issue: Rowset shape differs between success and failure
codeSmells.detail: Success returns three rowsets with the envelope LAST (index 2); failure returns the envelope alone at index 0. Fine for a hand-run script read in SSMS, but it is not the 'rowset 0 = envelope' convention, so do not wire it to a client as-is.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
